title: Additional 100 unique exact-auction-lot sourcing targets
purpose: Research task tracker. 100 NEW search slots, NOT a record of actual sourced, licensed or published cars
required_gates: Distinct real auction lot; do not reuse previous 37 published or any of 50 target slots as if they were the same vehicle
Exact same car in full-size pictures and full authentic original auction sheet (not schematic damage chart)
No street, dealer, outdoor lot, warehouse, parked, stock, AI-generated or mismatched images
Auction house, date, chassis/VIN, lot number, mileage, grade verified; price only if actual sale confirmed
Explicit evidenced rights to self-host/reuse both photos and auction sheet for commercial PapAuto website
Keep unapproved images and source URLs in research only, do not leak to customer cards
Only approved exact lots through importer dry run, unit/browser QA and Render verification before publication
No contacting auction houses or suppliers without separate user approval
notes: Drom analysis sampled 40 of 991 seen listings; not 991 individually audited
Avoid Japan domestic-market unsupported aliases Jazz, Micra, Qashqai in this 100-slot package until market-specific proof
Some Japan search targets request a DIFFERENT year window and physical lot in a model already planned among first 50
Some source URLs in the queue may not resolve or may be small thumbnails and may show non-auction photo contexts; none have verified full sheet/rights
